tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Balance, hourly spend, how long the balance lasts, servers against the account limit.

tools.name: list_options
tools.description: Plans with vCPU, RAM, disk, traffic, GPU, hourly and monthly price and the locations they deploy in, cheapest first. Filter by product, provider, location, GPU model and price.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: Data center locations with codes, cities and countries.

tools.name: list_os
tools.description: OS images with versions and one-click apps you can deploy.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Price of an order and whether the balance covers the first hour.

tools.name: create_server
tools.description: Create 1 to 3 servers (OS or one-click app) and charge the first hour. Refuses and returns the price when the total is above max_hourly_usd (default $1/h).

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: All servers with status, IPs, plan and an ssh command.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: One server with its current status and addresses.

tools.name: server_power
tools.description: Power actions. A stopped server is still billed.

tools.name: get_root_password
tools.description: The login and root password of a server (stays in the chat history).

tools.name: change_ip
tools.description: Give a Vultr server a new IPv4, same data. Small fee and a cooldown. Needs confirm and the exact name.

tools.name: destroy_server
tools.description: Delete a server and its disk; billing stops. Needs confirm=true and the exact name.

tools.name: get_rdns
tools.description: Current PTR records of the server's IPv4 and IPv6.

tools.name: set_rdns
tools.description: Set the PTR record of one of the server's IPs (Linode requires the name to resolve to the IP first).

tools.name: create_backup
tools.description: Start a snapshot of a server (pending, then available).

tools.name: restore_backup
tools.description: Create a NEW server from a backup (new IP); respects max_hourly_usd.

tools.name: delete_backup
tools.description: Delete a snapshot. Needs confirm=true and the exact label as name.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_root_password" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: The login and root password of a server (stays in the chat history).
